verdict.rationale: Runway Dev documents the loop for agents. A machine-readable llms.txt and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec are both probe-verified, and every docs page is also available as Markdown. Agents submit text-only prompts via `POST /v1/text_to_video` and watch the job by polling `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until it reaches SUCCEEDED or FAILED. Response metadata reports the model used and the realized cost in credits, priced at $0.01 per credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the output asset URL is returned and fetched from a succeeded task, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the full loop.
